mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO notification (user_id, category_id, type_code, target_month, threshold_rate, sent_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{typeCode}, #{targetMonth}, #{thresholdRate}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, user_id, category_id, type_code, target_month, threshold_rate, sent_at FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sent_at DESC
